items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Jonah, my name is Bud Yorkin. I'm the director of the Fred Astaire show.

ctx.x: And he said, "Then they come over to the house. And they said, 'Well, these people, we don't know anything about these people you're talking about. If you want to do a

show get names.'" He says, "Look. This here is what I want to do now, if you want me to do it." So finally after about six weeks they said, "Okay. You can get them and if anything goes wrong it's your fault." So he says okay. So now what they did while I'm playing out at Baker's again, Bud Yorkin is out in the audience and I don't know it. So he was a producer, you know, or a director or something. So he was sitting out there, so I got off after the last set, and he said, "Jonah, my name is Bud Yorkin. I'm the…
